summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) gestellt, gespannt sein (von einer Falle);
rationale: Supplies a missing sense heading for the inherited Detransitive Part. Pass. box; the result-state meaning is already present there.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (PrS 70/75)

data.turoyo: Ḥzele lu taʕlo faḥo malṣəyo. Kit falqo di gweto ʕal u faḥo.
data.translation: Da erblickte der Fuchs eine Falle, die gestellt war, und auf ihr lag ein Stück Käse;

rationale: Thin existing Detransitive Part. Pass./1 cell; independent singular attributive result state with bait context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (PrS 72/62)

data.turoyo: Mqadamle lu taʕlo lu ḥmoro. Ḥzele af faḥe malṣəye, omər: "Lə gbəsamli u muklo du ḥmoro."
data.translation: Als nun der Fuchs näher an den Esel herantrat, erblickte er dieselben, und zog sich daher zurück mit den Worten: "Ich habe gerade keine Lust auf Eselsfleisch."

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass./1 cell; unusual plural agreement malṣəye. German pronoun is retained from the edition and its antecedent remains a question.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (PrS 74/111)

data.turoyo: Kit faḥo mi qriṯo w larwal malṣəyo. Čik u taʕlo bu faḥo b lalyo, msik.
data.translation: <...> Aber draussen vor dem Orte war eine Falle gespannt; da es Nacht war, geriet er in diese und wurde gefangen.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass./1 cell; complete result-state and consequence, with unrelated German lead-in removed.

summary: Patient-oriented malṣəyo/malṣəye describe a ready/set trap, attributively or predicatively; they do not assert the setting event in the finite Preterit. The plural gives explicit patient agreement.

The l-marked watchman in PrS 69/3 is naturally a resumed possessor/affected person within kətle, not securely an external agent. No new agent-government rule is inferred from the active German perfect.

The supplied entry already has the Preterit, Infectum, Imperativ and Detransitive Part. Pass. contexts proposed as thin-cell additions. Their source identity is recognized despite PrS citation and transcription differences; only genuinely distinct result-state examples are added.
